# Overview {-}

**Author:** Sean Westwood

Part of the [demystR](https://demystr.github.io) series.

<div class="draft">Work in progress.</div>

- sampling and null distributions, p-values, error rates, power, all by simulation in R
- each idea: words, picture, equation, code
- aim: point at a term, see it in a figure, find the line of code

## Who This Book Is For {-}

- basic R
- builds on Demystifying Statistics (mean, variance, SD, t)

## How The Book Is Organised {-}

- Part 1, Sampling: sampling distributions, standard error and t
- Part 2, Testing: null distributions, p-values, error rates, power
- Part 3, Power in Practice: a priori power, sensitivity analysis, post hoc power

The chapters shown in grey italics in the contents have not been written yet; each one
describes what it will cover.
